consumers.imageInsertAction: Native plan executes current/assets/per-file/custom copy, upload, or normal save/reference.
consumers.imageCopyLocal: Existing local-file/YAML operations use the local gate.
consumers.imageCopyOnline: Online HTML/URI paste invokes native download/copy/upload when the online rule is active.
consumers.allowImageUpload: YAML upload/ipic permission is checked; global upload remains independent.
consumers.useRelativeImagePaths: Native display paths are relative only below the document folder.
consumers.relativeImageDotPrefix: Native generated relative paths optionally include ./ including hidden-file names.
consumers.escapeImageURLs: Renderer formats readable or escaped local image destinations; network URLs retain URI semantics.
consumers.imageUploader: Custom, uPic, Picsee, PicGo/PicList call real providers; missing or unsupported providers return real errors.
consumers.customImageFolder: Native folder plan expands each filename token without its final extension.
consumers.customImageUploadCommand: Native Bash command receives document macros via environment and images as separate literal argv. Process groups enforce cancellation/timeouts.

integration.fileDrop: Calls root-owned handleNonImageFileDrop(event,view) before normal image flow.
integration.cancellation: Renderer reset/destroy cancels sent requests; root wired native fileURL change/close to cancelAllClipboardImages.
integration.uploaderTest: ImageUploaderTester.start(requestId:values:completion:) and cancel(requestId:) execute two temporary own PNGs; no system clipboard.

limitations: iPic named-pasteboard/keyed-archive integration is not implemented; its selection reports unavailable.
Live third-party uploader apps/accounts/cloud round trips were not tested. uPic/Picsee protocols and PicGo/PicList loopback are source-backed implementations.
Original raw screenshot gate is not proven. Replica preserves its established raw screenshot copy/save behavior.
YAML upload refusal retains the source; the original enable-permission dialog is not yet implemented.
Project image settings, typora-root-url, FTP download, and original YAML absolute-path corner cases remain unverified or unfinished.
Actual native user save/copy panels were not opened in this helper suite; pending UI integration belongs to the coordinator.
Default relative/escape settings preserve prior replica behavior and are not verified macOS factory defaults.
